name: astrdsh-relay-workspace
description: AstrDsh Relay（星驿）工作区根：只放闸门入口，不再是可分发的包。DSH 侧包在 dsh-astrbot-relay/，AstrBot 侧插件在 astrbot_plugin_dsh_relay/。

scripts.check:py: python -m py_compile astrbot_plugin_dsh_relay/contract.py astrbot_plugin_dsh_relay/location_text.py astrbot_plugin_dsh_relay/main.py && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('astrbot_plugin_dsh_relay/__pycache__',{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.test: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:py && npm run check:contract && npm run test:location && npm run test:location-text && npm run check:version
